verdict.rationale: v0 docs confirm integrations with databases like Neon (Postgres) and Upstash (Redis), plus backend services like Supabase, directly connectable within Projects without leaving the builder (v0-docs-28, v0-docs-24, v0-docs-35, v0-docs-40). However, evidence doesn't show the actual provisioning UX (e.g., creating a new DB instance vs. connecting an existing one) or confirm env vars/schema wiring happen automatically, and no independent/community hands-on account validates this specific workflow. missing for 10: hands-on/independent confirmation of end-to-end DB provisioning flow, detail on whether v0 creates new database instances or only connects existing ones, confirmation of automatic schema/env wiring without manual steps.
